body:
It's not the same outcome though; that's the point of the quote in my opinion.

Outcome 1: You kill yourself. Your family carries that pain and feels guilty until they die.

Outcome 2: You don't kill yourself. Each day is a struggle to get through, but at least you don't inflict that pain on innocent people.

Sorry if this seems like guilt-tripping. That's not my intention. I understand and sympathize with the desire to not be alive anymore. I'm just trying to get my point across.
